name: Bakery & Cafe
description: Combines a production artisan bakery with a sit-down cafe experience. Features hearth-baked breads, morning viennoiserie, specialty espresso coffee, assembled-to-order sandwiches, and light morning meals without full commercial kitchen cooking.

sections.name: Artisan Breads & Loaves
sections.description: House-baked sourdoughs, hearth loaves, baguettes, and specialty grain breads crafted on-site daily using long fermentation. Represents the core production bakery foundation, serving takeaway customers seeking daily table bread as well as supplying breads for in-house cafe dining.

subSections.name: Sourdoughs & Country Loaves
subSections.description: Naturally leavened wild-yeast boules and rustic country loaves with blistered crusts and open crumb structures.

subSections.name: Baguettes & Batards
subSections.description: Classic French-style baguettes, epi baguettes, and oblong batards baked with hearth steam for maximum crust crackle.

subSections.name: Sandwich & Table Breads
subSections.description: Soft-crusted pullman sandwich loaves, Japanese milk bread, and enriched brioche loaves ideal for home slicing and toasting.

subSections.name: Specialty Grain Breads
subSections.description: Hearty whole wheat, seeded rye, spelt, and ancient grain loaves offering rich nuttiness and dense nutritional value.

subSections.name: Rolls & Buns
subSections.description: Individual dinner rolls, brioche burger buns, and sourdough pull-apart rolls sold individually or in multi-packs.

choices.label: Thick Sliced / Texas Cut (~18mm - French toast & hearty melts)

sections.name: Morning Pastries & Viennoiserie
sections.description: Laminated, flaky, and enriched morning pastries baked before dawn each day. Anchors the morning cafe trade, pairing directly with morning coffee and tea orders for both dine-in guests and quick morning commuters.

subSections.name: Laminated Pastries
subSections.description: Layered French butter croissants, pain au chocolat, twice-baked almond croissants, and caramelized kouign-amann.

subSections.name: Danishes & Fruit Pastries
subSections.description: Crisp laminated Danish pockets, pinwheels, and crowns filled with vanilla pastry cream, cream cheese, and seasonal fruit preserves.

subSections.name: Brioches & Sweet Breads
subSections.description: Enriched sweet bakes including Swedish cardamom knots, cinnamon morning buns, babka slices, and sugar-crusted brioche rounds.

subSections.name: Muffins & Scones
subSections.description: Freshly scooped fruit muffins, traditional English buttermilk scones, and savory herb and cheese scones.

sections.name: Cakes & Sweet Treats
sections.description: Individually portioned sweet confectionery, decadent layer cake cuts, cookies, brownies, and tartlets. Designed for casual afternoon tea accompaniments, dessert cravings, and takeaway dessert boxes.

subSections.name: Individual Pastries & Slices
subSections.description: Delicate fruit tartlets, French eclairs, choux buns, opera cake slices, and layered mille-feuille.

subSections.name: Cookies & Brownies
subSections.description: Chunky soft-baked cookies, fudgy chocolate brownies, blondies, and delicate shortbread biscuits.

subSections.name: Display Cakes (by the slice)
subSections.description: Portioned wedges cut fresh daily from our counter display sponge cakes, cheesecakes, and tea loaves.

choices.label: Warmed with Side of Fresh Cream

sections.name: Whole & Celebration Cakes
sections.description: Full-size specialty cakes and gateaux for birthdays, family gatherings, milestones, and office celebrations. Offers both ready-made whole cakes in display coolers for same-day pickup and advance custom orders with piping inscriptions.

subSections.name: Ready-to-Go Whole Cakes
subSections.description: Fully finished, refrigerated whole cakes available for immediate same-day takeaway directly from our bakery cold case.

subSections.name: Pre-Order Custom Cakes
subSections.description: Custom finished celebration cakes requiring 24 to 48 hours notice with selectable flavors, frostings, and decorative piped messages.

sections.name: Breakfast & Brunch
sections.description: Plated morning dishes spotlighting our artisan breads alongside farm eggs, grains, yogurts, and seasonal toppings. Focuses on swift cafe counter assembly (toasting, slicing, poaching, folding) without heavy commercial kitchen frying or grill hoods.

subSections.name: Toast & Egg Plates
subSections.description: Thick-cut artisan sourdough toast paired with farm eggs, smashed avocado, herbed ricotta, and savory spreads.

subSections.name: Bowls & Granola
subSections.description: House-baked honey-nut granola bowls, Greek yogurt parfaits, overnight soaked oats, and acai fruit bowls.

subSections.name: Pastry Platters & Shares
subSections.description: Curated breakfast boards combining mini breakfast pastries, cultured butter, regional fruit preserves, and sliced cheeses.

timeBehavior.note: Breakfast & Brunch items are prepared fresh to order during morning hours (07:00–12:00).

sections.name: Sandwiches & Light Bites
sections.description: Freshly assembled savory sandwiches, toasted panini melts, and filled flatbread wraps showcasing bakery-fresh baguettes, focaccias, and batards. Composed to order with deli meats, artisanal cheeses, and fresh vegetables without heavy cooking.

subSections.name: Cold Sandwiches
subSections.description: Crusty filled baguettes, deli-style rye sandwiches, and club sandwiches stacked with cured meats, salad greens, and house dressings.

subSections.name: Hot Sandwiches & Toasties
subSections.description: Pressed sourdough toasties, French croque monsieur, hot focaccia panini, and melted reubens.

subSections.name: Wraps
subSections.description: Hand-rolled soft flour and whole grain wraps packed with marinated proteins, crisp vegetables, and light emulsified dressings.

sections.name: Soups & Salads
sections.description: Simmered kettle soups served alongside crusty sourdough hunks, paired with seasonal composed salads displayed in the deli counter. Delivers nutritious, wholesome midday meal combinations for sit-down cafe patrons.

subSections.name: Daily Soups
subSections.description: Daily kettle soups including roasted vegetable bisques, velvety chowders, and legume broths served with thick artisan bread.

subSections.name: Seasonal Salads
subSections.description: Market-fresh grain bowls, tossed crisp greens, roasted vegetable medleys, and pasta salads prepared daily in small batches.

sections.name: Hot Beverages
sections.description: Comprehensive cafe hot drink bar powered by a multi-group commercial espresso machine, precision batch filter brewers, and loose-leaf tea pots. Essential companion to all bakery products throughout the day.

subSections.name: Espresso-Based Coffee
subSections.description: Double espresso, macchiato, cortado, flat white, cappuccino, caffe latte, and long black extracted to exacting barista standards.

subSections.name: Brewed & Filter Coffee
subSections.description: Rotating single-origin batch brews, manual V60 pour-overs, and French press pots emphasizing delicate coffee flavor notes.

subSections.name: Tea Selection
subSections.description: Loose-leaf black, green, oolong, and caffeine-free herbal tisanes served steeped in personal infuser teapots.

subSections.name: Specialty Hot Drinks
subSections.description: Slow-brewed spiced chai lattes, ceremonial Japanese matcha lattes, turmeric golden milk, and rich Belgian hot chocolate.

sections.name: Cold & Blended Beverages
sections.description: Iced coffee classics, slow-steeped 18-hour cold brews, ice-blended frappes, and wholesome fruit smoothies. Drives high-ticket afternoon beverage sales and provides chilled refreshment for dine-in and takeout guests.

subSections.name: Iced Coffee & Cold Brew
subSections.description: Over-ice espresso lattes, nitro cold brew on draught, iced Americanos, and velvety sweet cream cold foam drinks.

subSections.name: Blended & Frappe
subSections.description: Coffee and cream-based frappes blended with ice, crowned with whipped cream and cocoa dusting or caramel swirls.

subSections.name: Smoothies
subSections.description: Nutrient-dense smoothies blended with frozen berries, tropical fruits, baby spinach, banana, and plant milks.

sections.name: Fresh Juices & Soft Drinks
sections.description: House-pressed fruit juices, refreshing cold citrus lemonades, artisan bottled tonics, effervescent kombuchas, and sparkling waters. Fulfills family, children, and non-caffeinated customer needs.

subSections.name: Fresh Juices
subSections.description: Cold-pressed daily orange juice, crisp ginger-apple blends, and antioxidant-rich green detox juices.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks & Water
subSections.description: House-brewed iced tea, cloudy lemonade, artisanal sodas, organic kombuchas, and bottled still or sparkling mineral waters.

sections.name: Retail & Take-Home
sections.description: Packaged gourmet retail goods that extend the bakery-cafe experience into customer households. Enables customers to purchase whole bean coffee, pantry spreads, dry baking provisions, and branded gifts at checkout.

subSections.name: Bakery Take-Home
subSections.description: Bake-at-home frozen croissant dough, artisan sourdough crisps, seasoned salad croutons, and active sourdough starter kits.

subSections.name: Coffee Beans & Accessories
subSections.description: House blend and single-origin whole bean coffee bags (250g / 1kg), paper filter packs, and reusable thermal travel tumblers.

subSections.name: Jams & Spreads
subSections.description: Glass jars of small-batch seasonal jams, local raw honey, chocolate hazelnut praline spread, and savory onion chutney.

subSections.name: Gift Items
subSections.description: Linen bread storage bags, branded canvas tote bags, digital/physical gift cards, and curated breakfast gift boxes.

sections.name: Seasonal Specials
sections.description: Time-limited seasonal creations celebrating seasonal holiday bakes, fruit harvests, and creative barista experiments. Creates marketing novelty and encourages repeat visits from neighborhood regulars.

subSections.name: Holiday Drinks
subSections.description: Festive seasonal drinks including gingerbread lattes, spiced pumpkin cold brew, eggnog cappuccinos, and mulled spiced apple cider.

subSections.name: Seasonal Pastries
subSections.description: Harvest-driven baked goods including stone fruit galettes, Easter hot cross buns, holiday stollen, and winter galette des rois.

subSections.name: Limited Collabs
subSections.description: Exclusive guest roaster beans, collaboration pastries with local chocolatiers, and limited weekend pop-up specials.

systemFeatures.name: Pre-Order & Advance Booking
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to reserve whole celebration cakes, weekend bread loaves, and pastry gift boxes with designated pickup dates and cutoff times.

systemFeatures.name: Oven Batch Schedule Windows
systemFeatures.description: Displays live and scheduled baking times so customers know exactly when sourdough bread and morning croissants emerge warm from the oven.

systemFeatures.name: Live Stock & Urgency Badges
systemFeatures.description: Provides real-time scarcity and fresh-bake badges including 'Freshly Baked', 'Sold Out for Today', and 'Limited Batch' to manage customer expectations.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Tagging
systemFeatures.description: Highlights key allergens like gluten, dairy, nuts, and eggs while empowering customers to filter menu items by dietary preferences such as vegan and vegetarian.

systemFeatures.name: Milk Alternatives & Drink Customization
systemFeatures.description: Provides comprehensive barista customization options for plant-based milks, ice levels, sweetness levels, and extra espresso shots across hot and cold beverages.

systemFeatures.name: Custom Cake Inscription Piping
systemFeatures.description: Captures personalized piped text messages and celebratory greetings directly on whole celebration cakes during checkout.

systemFeatures.name: Meal Time Restrictions & Menu Dayparts
systemFeatures.description: Enforces time-of-day availability windows to restrict morning items like Breakfast & Brunch to 07:00–12:00 without disrupting all-day bakery and beverage ordering.
